        "contents": "export class UAPMonitorService {\n...\nexport class UAPMonitorService {\n\tprivate twitter: TwitterApi;\n\n\n\t...\n\n\n\tprivate async getRSSSightings(): Promise\u003cUAPSighting[]\u003e {\n\t\ttry {\n\t\t\tconst response = await fetch(RSS_FEED_URL);\n\t\t\tconst xmlData = await response.text();\n\t\t\tconst result = this.xmlParser.parse(xmlData);\n\n\t\t\tconst entries = result.feed.entry || [];\n\n\t\t\treturn entries.map((entry: any) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\tconst content = this.stripHtmlTags(\n\t\t\t\t\tentry.content || entry.summary || \"\",\n\t\t\t\t);\n\n\t\t\t\treturn {\n\t\t\t\t\tid: &#96;rss-${entry.id || Buffer.from(entry.link).toString(\"base64\")}&#96;,\n\t\t\t\t\tsource: \"rss\",\n\t\t\t\t\ttitle: entry.title,\n\t\t\t\t\tcontent: content.substring(0, 500),\n\t\t\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tstate: \"NJ\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcity: this.extractNJCity(content),\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t\ttimestamp: new Date(entry.published || entry.updated),\n\t\t\t\t\tmediaUrls: this.extractMediaUrls(content),\n\t\t\t\t\tsourceUrl: entry.link,\n\t\t\t\t\tcategory: this.categorizeContent(content),\n\t\t\t\t\tconfidence: this.determineConfidence(content),\n\t\t\t\t\ttype: this.determineType(content),\n\t\t\t\t};\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t} catch (error) {\n\t\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching RSS feed:\", error);\n\t\t\treturn [];\n\t\t}\n\t}",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst NEWS_SOURCES = [\n\t\"nj.com\",\n\t\"northjersey.com\",\n\t\"app.com\",\n\t\"pressofatlanticcity.com\",\n];\n\nconst RSS_FEED_URL =\n\t\"https://www.google.com/alerts/feeds/16053521018490207112/10287189927525032770\";\n\nexport class UAPMonitorService {\n\tprivate twitter: TwitterApi;\n\tprivate xmlParser: XMLParser;\n\n\tconstructor() {\n\t\tthis.twitter = new TwitterApi(process.env.TWITTER_BEARER_TOKEN!);\n\t\tthis.xmlParser = new XMLParser({\n\t\t\tignoreAttributes: false,\n\t\t\tattributeNamePrefix: \"@_\",\n\t\t});\n\t}",

        "contents": "export class UAPMonitorService {\n...\nexport class UAPMonitorService {\n\tprivate twitter: TwitterApi;\n\n\n\t...\n\n\n\tprivate async getNewsSightings(): Promise\u003cUAPSighting[]\u003e {\n\t\tconst sightings: UAPSighting[] = [];\n\n\t\tfor (const source of NEWS_SOURCES) {\n\t\t\tconst response = await fetch(&#96;https://${source}&#96;);\n\t\t\tconst html = await response.text();\n\t\t\tconst $ = load(html);\n\n\t\t\t// Search for articles containing UAP/UFO keywords\n\t\t\t$(\"article\").each((_, article) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\tconst content = $(article).text().toLowerCase();\n\t\t\t\tif (content.includes(\"ufo\") || content.includes(\"uap\")) {\n\t\t\t\t\tconst title = $(article).find(\"h1, h2\").first().text();\n\t\t\t\t\tconst url = $(article).find(\"a\").first().attr(\"href\");\n\t\t\t\t\tconst images = $(article)\n\t\t\t\t\t\t.find(\"img\")\n\t\t\t\t\t\t.map((_, img) =\u003e $(img).attr(\"src\"))\n\t\t\t\t\t\t.get();\n\n\t\t\t\t\tsightings.push({\n\t\t\t\t\t\tid: &#96;news-${Buffer.from(url || \"\").toString(\"base64\")}&#96;,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tsource: \"news\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttitle,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcontent: content.substring(0, 500),\n\t\t\t\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstate: \"NJ\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcity: this.extractNJCity(content),\n\t\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttimestamp: new Date(),\n\t\t\t\t\t\tmediaUrls: images,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tsourceUrl: url || \"\",\n\t\t\t\t\t});\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn sightings;\n\t}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Normalize both sightings and events data into a common format for analysis\n *\n * @param combinedData - Raw array containing both sightings and events data\n * @returns Normalized data array\n */\nfunction normalizeDataForAnalysis(combinedData: any[]): any[] {\n\treturn combinedData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\t// Determine if this is a sighting or event item based on properties\n\t\tconst isEvent = item.category !== undefined;\n\n\t\t// Create a common data structure for analysis\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: isEvent ? \"event\" : \"sighting\",\n\t\t\ttitle: isEvent ? item.title || item.name : item.title || \"UAP Sighting\",\n\t\t\tdescription: isEvent ? item.description : item.content,\n\t\t\tdate: isEvent ? item.date : item.timestamp,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: isEvent ? item.location : item.location?.city || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates: isEvent\n\t\t\t\t\t? { lat: item.latitude, lng: item.longitude }\n\t\t\t\t\t: item.location?.coordinates,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t// Properties specific to sightings\n\t\t\tshape: !isEvent ? item.shape || item.category?.[0] : undefined,\n\t\t\t// Properties specific to events\n\t\t\tcategory: isEvent ? item.category : undefined,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item, // Keep the original item for reference\n\t\t};\n\t});\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Normalize both sightings and events data into a common format for analysis\n *\n * @param combinedData - Raw array containing both sightings and events data\n * @returns Normalized data array\n */\nfunction normalizeDataForAnalysis(combinedData: any[]): any[] {\n\treturn combinedData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\t// Determine if this is a sighting or event item based on properties\n\t\tconst isEvent = item.category !== undefined;\n\n\t\t// Create a common data structure for analysis\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: isEvent ? \"event\" : \"sighting\",\n\t\t\ttitle: isEvent ? item.title || item.name : item.title || \"UAP Sighting\",\n\t\t\tdescription: isEvent ? item.description : item.content,\n\t\t\tdate: isEvent ? item.date : item.timestamp,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: isEvent ? item.location : item.location?.city || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates: isEvent\n\t\t\t\t\t? { lat: item.latitude, lng: item.longitude }\n\t\t\t\t\t: item.location?.coordinates,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t// Properties specific to sightings\n\t\t\tshape: !isEvent ? item.shape || item.category?.[0] : undefined,\n\t\t\t// Properties specific to events\n\t\t\tcategory: isEvent ? item.category : undefined,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item, // Keep the original item for reference\n\t\t};\n\t});\n}",

        "contents": "export async function getSightingsByTimeChunk(\n...\nexport async function getSightingsByTimeChunk(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n\tlimit = 100,\n): Promise\u003cValidatedUAPSighting[]\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\n\n\t\t\t\t...\n\n\n\t\t\t\t// Use these records instead since date filtering isn't working\n\t\t\t\tconst mappedSightings = allSightingsLimit.records\n\t\t\t\t\t.map((record: XataRecord) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttry {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t// Use Xata's built-in serialization\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tconst serializedRecord = record.toSerializable\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t? record.toSerializable()\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t: sanitizeXataRecord(record);\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tconst timestamp = serializedRecord.date\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t? new Date(serializedRecord.date)\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t: new Date();\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t// Transform from Xata format to UAPSighting format\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\treturn {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tid: serializedRecord.id,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tsource: \"news\", // Default source\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\ttitle:\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tserializedRecord.description?.substring(0, 50) ||\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"UAP Sighting\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcontent: serializedRecord.description || \"\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcity: serializedRecord.city || undefined,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstate: \"NJ\", // Default for now\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcoordinates:\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tserializedRecord.latitude \u0026\u0026 serializedRecord.longitude\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t? {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlat: serializedRecord.latitude,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlng: serializedRecord.longitude,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t: undefined,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\ttimestamp,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tmediaUrls: serializedRecord.media_link\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t? [serializedRecord.media_link]\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t: [],\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tsourceUrl: serializedRecord.media_link || \"\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcategory: serializedRecord.shape\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t? [serializedRecord.shape]\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t: [],\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tconfidence: \"medium\", // Default confidence\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\ttype: \"sighting\", // Default type\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t} as ValidatedUAPSighting;\n\t\t\t\t\t\t} catch (error) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tconsole.error(\"Error mapping unfiltered sighting:\", error);\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\treturn null;\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t\t\t.filter(Boolean) as ValidatedUAPSighting[];\n\n\t\t\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"🔍 Mapped\",\n\t\t\t\t\tmappedSightings.length,\n\t\t\t\t\t\"unfiltered sightings\",\n\t\t\t\t);\n\t\t\t\tif (mappedSightings.length \u003e 0) {\n\t\t\t\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\"🔍 Sample of unfiltered sightings:\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tmappedSightings.slice(0, 2),\n\t\t\t\t\t);\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t// Return these sightings instead, ignoring date filtering\n\t\t\t\treturn mappedSightings;\n\t\t\t}",

        "contents": "import { xata } from '@/db/xata/client';\nimport { ValidatedUAPSighting, UAPSightingSchema } from './uap-sighting';\n\n/**\n * Fetch sightings within a specified time range\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getSightingsByTimeChunk(\n  startYear: number = 1940,\n  endYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n  limit: number = 100\n): Promise\u003cValidatedUAPSighting[]\u003e {\n  try {\n    // Calculate date range\n    const startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n    const endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n    // Use Xata's filter to get sightings within date range\n    const sightingsRecords = await xata.db.sightings\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .sort('date', 'desc')\n      .getPaginated({\n        pagination: {\n          size: limit\n        }\n      });",

[record.shape] \n          : [],\n        confidence: 'medium', // Default confidence\n        type: 'sighting' // Default type\n      };\n      \n      // Validate with schema\n      try {\n        return UAPSightingSchema.parse(transformed);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Schema validation error:', error);\n        return null;\n      }\n    }).filter(Boolean) as ValidatedUAPSighting[];\n\n    return sightings;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching sightings by time chunk:', error);\n    return [];\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Normalize both sightings and events data into a common format for analysis\n *\n * @param combinedData - Raw array containing both sightings and events data\n * @returns Normalized data array\n */\nfunction normalizeDataForAnalysis(combinedData: any[]): any[] {\n\treturn combinedData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\t// Determine if this is a sighting or event item based on properties\n\t\tconst isEvent = item.category !== undefined;\n\n\t\t// Create a common data structure for analysis\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: isEvent ? \"event\" : \"sighting\",\n\t\t\ttitle: isEvent ? item.title || item.name : item.title || \"UAP Sighting\",\n\t\t\tdescription: isEvent ? item.description : item.content,\n\t\t\tdate: isEvent ? item.date : item.timestamp,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: isEvent ? item.location : item.location?.city || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates: isEvent\n\t\t\t\t\t? { lat: item.latitude, lng: item.longitude }\n\t\t\t\t\t: item.location?.coordinates,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t// Properties specific to sightings\n\t\t\tshape: !isEvent ? item.shape || item.category?.[0] : undefined,\n\t\t\t// Properties specific to events\n\t\t\tcategory: isEvent ? item.category : undefined,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item, // Keep the original item for reference\n\t\t};\n\t});\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for events based on time range\n * Uses Xata's aggregate functionality for efficient computation\n */\nexport async function getEventsStats(\n  startYear: number = 1940,\n  endYear: number = new Date().getFullYear()\n) {\n  try {\n    // Calculate date range\n    const startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n    const endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n    // Use Xata's aggregate to get category distribution\n    const categoryAggregation = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        categoryDistribution: {\n          distinctCount: {\n            column: 'id',\n            groupBy: 'category'\n          }\n        }\n      });\n    \n    // Get time series data by year\n    const timeSeriesAggregation = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        eventsByYear: {\n          count: {\n            groupBy: {\n              dateColumn: 'date',\n              method: 'byYear'\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      });\n\n    // Aggregate by location\n    const locationAggregation = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        eventsByLocation: {\n          count: {\n            groupBy: 'location'\n          }\n        }\n      });\n\n    return {\n      total: timeSeriesAggregation.aggs.eventsByYear.reduce(\n        (sum, item) =\u003e sum + item.count, 0\n      ),\n      categoryDistribution: categoryAggregation.aggs.categoryDistribution,\n      timeseriesData: timeSeriesAggregation.aggs.eventsByYear,\n      locationData: locationAggregation.aggs.eventsByLocation,\n      timeRange: {\n        startYear,\n        endYear\n      }\n    };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching events stats:', error);\n    return {\n      total: 0,\n      categoryDistribution: [],\n      timeseriesData: [],\n      locationData: [],\n      timeRange: {\n        startYear,\n        endYear\n      }\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "\"use server\";\n\nimport { xata } from '@/db/xata/client';\n\n/**\n * Fetch events within a specified time range, with pagination\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getEventsByTimeChunk(\n  startYear: number = 1940,\n  endYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n  limit: number = 100\n) {\n  try {\n    // Calculate date range\n    const startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n    const endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n    // Use Xata's filter to get events within date range\n    const eventsRecords = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .sort('date', 'desc')\n      .getPaginated({\n        pagination: {\n          size: limit\n        }\n      });\n\n    return eventsRecords.records;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching events by time chunk:', error);\n    return [];\n  }\n}",

        "originalContents": "\"use server\";\n\nimport { xata } from '@/db/xata/client';\n\n/**\n * Fetch events within a specified time range, with pagination\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getEventsByTimeChunk(\n  startYear: number = 1940,\n  endYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n  limit: number = 100\n) {\n  try {\n    // Calculate date range\n    const startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n    const endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n    // Use Xata's filter to get events within date range\n    const eventsRecords = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .sort('date', 'desc')\n      .getPaginated({\n        pagination: {\n          size: limit\n        }\n      });\n\n    return eventsRecords.records;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching events by time chunk:', error);\n    return [];\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Fetch a paginated batch of events data with time ranges\n * @param timeRanges Array of time ranges to query\n * @param limit Maximum records per time range\n */\nexport async function getEventsBatched(\n  timeRanges: {startYear: number, endYear: number}[],\n  limit: number = 50\n) {\n  try {\n    // Process batches in parallel\n    const batchPromises = timeRanges.map(range =\u003e \n      getEventsByTimeChunk(range.startYear, range.endYear, limit)\n    );\n\n    // Stats for the full range\n    const startYear = Math.min(...timeRanges.map(r =\u003e r.startYear));\n    const endYear = Math.max(...timeRanges.map(r =\u003e r.endYear));\n    const statsPromise = getEventsStats(startYear, endYear);\n\n    // Wait for all promises to resolve\n    const [batchResults, stats] = await Promise.all([\n      Promise.all(batchPromises),\n      statsPromise\n    ]);\n\n    // Merge all batches\n    const allEvents = batchResults.flat();\n    \n    return {\n      events: allEvents,\n      stats\n    };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching batched events:', error);\n    return {\n      events: [],\n      stats: null\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Normalize both sightings and events data into a common format for analysis\n *\n * @param combinedData - Raw array containing both sightings and events data\n * @returns Normalized data array\n */\nfunction normalizeDataForAnalysis(combinedData: any[]): any[] {\n\treturn combinedData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\t// Determine if this is a sighting or event item based on properties\n\t\tconst isEvent = item.category !== undefined;\n\n\t\t// Create a common data structure for analysis\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: isEvent ? \"event\" : \"sighting\",\n\t\t\ttitle: isEvent ? item.title || item.name : item.title || \"UAP Sighting\",\n\t\t\tdescription: isEvent ? item.description : item.content,\n\t\t\tdate: isEvent ? item.date : item.timestamp,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: isEvent ? item.location : item.location?.city || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates: isEvent\n\t\t\t\t\t? { lat: item.latitude, lng: item.longitude }\n\t\t\t\t\t: item.location?.coordinates,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t// Properties specific to sightings\n\t\t\tshape: !isEvent ? item.shape || item.category?.[0] : undefined,\n\t\t\t// Properties specific to events\n\t\t\tcategory: isEvent ? item.category : undefined,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item, // Keep the original item for reference\n\t\t};\n\t});\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Normalize both sightings and events data into a common format for analysis\n *\n * @param combinedData - Raw array containing both sightings and events data\n * @returns Normalized data array\n */\nfunction normalizeDataForAnalysis(combinedData: any[]): any[] {\n\treturn combinedData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\t// Determine if this is a sighting or event item based on properties\n\t\tconst isEvent = item.category !== undefined;\n\n\t\t// Create a common data structure for analysis\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: isEvent ? \"event\" : \"sighting\",\n\t\t\ttitle: isEvent ? item.title || item.name : item.title || \"UAP Sighting\",\n\t\t\tdescription: isEvent ? item.description : item.content,\n\t\t\tdate: isEvent ? item.date : item.timestamp,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: isEvent ? item.location : item.location?.city || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates: isEvent\n\t\t\t\t\t? { lat: item.latitude, lng: item.longitude }\n\t\t\t\t\t: item.location?.coordinates,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t// Properties specific to sightings\n\t\t\tshape: !isEvent ? item.shape || item.category?.[0] : undefined,\n\t\t\t// Properties specific to events\n\t\t\tcategory: isEvent ? item.category : undefined,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item, // Keep the original item for reference\n\t\t};\n\t});\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Prepares a summary of combined sightings and events data for AI analysis\n *\n * @param normalizedData - Normalized data array containing both sightings and events\n * @returns Summarized data suitable for AI analysis\n */\nfunction prepareCombinedDataSummary(normalizedData: any[]): any {\n\t// Limit the number of full descriptions to avoid token limits\n\tconst MAX_FULL_DESCRIPTIONS = 50;\n\n\t// Separate sightings and events\n\tconst sightings = normalizedData.filter((item) =\u003e item.type === \"sighting\");\n\tconst events = normalizedData.filter((item) =\u003e item.type === \"event\");\n\n\t// Create a combined summary\n\tconst summary = {\n\t\ttotalSightings: sightings.length,\n\t\ttotalEvents: events.length,\n\t\tlocationData: normalizedData.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\tlocation: item.location?.name || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\tcoordinates: item.location?.coordinates || null,\n\t\t})),\n\t\ttemporalData: normalizedData.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\tdate: item.date,\n\t\t})),\n\t\tshapeData: sightings.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\tshape: item.shape || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t})),\n\t\tcategoryData: events.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t})),\n\t\t// Limit full descriptions to save tokens\n\t\tdescriptions: normalizedData\n\t\t\t.slice(0, MAX_FULL_DESCRIPTIONS)\n\t\t\t.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\t\tdescription: item.description || \"No description\",\n\t\t\t})),\n\t};\n\n\treturn summary;\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for sightings based on time range\n * Uses Xata's aggregate functionality to efficiently compute stats\n */\nexport async function getSightingsStats(\n  startYear: number = 1940,\n  endYear: number = new Date().getFullYear()\n) {\n  try {\n    // Calculate date range\n    const startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n    const endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n    // Use Xata's aggregate to get shape distribution\n    const shapesAggregation = await xata.db.sightings\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        shapeDistribution: {\n          distinctCount: {\n            column: 'id',\n            groupBy: 'shape'\n          }\n        }\n      });\n    \n    // Use aggregate for time series data by year\n    const timeSeriesAggregation = await xata.db.sightings\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        sightingsByYear: {\n          count: {\n            groupBy: {\n              dateColumn: 'date',\n              method: 'byYear'\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      });\n\n    // Aggregate by location\n    const locationAggregation = await xata.db.sightings\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        sightingsByLocation: {\n          count: {\n            groupBy: 'city'\n          }\n        }\n      });\n\n    return {\n      total: timeSeriesAggregation.aggs.sightingsByYear.reduce(\n        (sum, item) =\u003e sum + item.count, 0\n      ),\n      shapeDistribution: shapesAggregation.aggs.shapeDistribution,\n      timeseriesData: timeSeriesAggregation.aggs.sightingsByYear,\n      locationData: locationAggregation.aggs.sightingsByLocation,\n      timeRange: {\n        startYear,\n        endYear\n      }\n    };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching sightings stats:', error);\n    return {\n      total: 0,\n      shapeDistribution: [],\n      timeseriesData: [],\n      locationData: [],\n      timeRange: {\n        startYear,\n        endYear\n      }\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Groups sightings by decade and returns a Record mapping decade labels to arrays of sightings\n * Example output: { \"1950-1959\": [...sightings], \"1960-1969\": [...sightings], ... }\n */\nexport function groupSightingsByDecade(sightings: any[]) {\n\treturn sightings.reduce((decades: Record\u003cstring, any[]\u003e, sighting) =\u003e {\n\t\tif (!sighting.timestamp \u0026\u0026 !sighting.date) return decades;\n\t\t\n\t\tconst date = sighting.timestamp || sighting.date;\n\t\tconst year = new Date(date).getFullYear();\n\t\tconst decadeStart = Math.floor(year / 10) * 10;\n\t\tconst decadeLabel = &#96;${decadeStart}-${decadeStart + 9}&#96;;\n\t\t\n\t\tif (!decades[decadeLabel]) {\n\t\t\tdecades[decadeLabel] = [];\n\t\t}\n\t\t\n\t\tdecades[decadeLabel].push(sighting);\n\t\treturn decades;\n\t}, {});\n}",

The error you're seeing is a serialization problem in Next.js - you're trying to pass non-serializable objects from a Server Component to a Client Component.

This typically happens when the Xata client returns objects with methods, prototypes, or circular references that can't be serialized for the client. Based on the error, you're trying to pass file/media objects with properties like `signedUrl`, `uploadUrl`, etc.

To fix this, you need to transform the Xata response into plain JavaScript objects before passing them to client components:

```typescript
// Instead of directly returning Xata records

return records; // This will fail

// Do this instead - create plain objects with only the data you need
const records = await xata.db.someTable.getAll();
const serializedRecords = records.map(record => ({
  id: record.id,
  name: record.name,
  url: record.url,
  // Only include the properties you need
  // Avoid including methods or complex nested objects
}));
return serializedRecords;
```

If you're already using `.toSerializable()` but still getting this error, you might need to go a step further and manually clean the objects:

  delete plainObject.signedUrl;
  delete plainObject.uploadUrl;
  return plainObject;
});
```

This issue often happens with file/media fields in Xata, as they contain complex metadata that's not JSON-serializable.

_**Agent**_

Let me examine both serialization options for passing Xata records from Server Components to Client Components:

### Option 1: JSON.stringify/parse

```javascript
// Server Component
const serializedData = JSON.stringify(complexData);
<ClientComponent data={serializedData} />

// Client Component
const parsedData = JSON.parse(props.data);
```

**Pros:**
- Simple, built-in JavaScript solution
- Works reliably for basic data structures
- Predictable output format

**Cons:**
- Loses type information (e.g., Dates become strings)
- Cannot handle circular references 
- Cannot serialize functions or class instances
- File objects with methods will be simplified

### Option 2: Next.js internal serialize/deserialize

```javascript
import { serialize, deserialize } from 'next/dist/lib/utils';

// Server Component
const serializedData = serialize(complexData);

// Client Component
const deserializedData = deserialize(props.data);
```

**Pros:**
- Designed specifically for Next.js RSC boundary
- May handle some complex cases better

**Cons:**
- Internal API not officially documented
- May change between Next.js versions
- Still won't fully handle Xata's file objects

### Recommendation:

For your Xata records with file attachments, I recommend **Option 1** with a preprocessing step:

```javascript
// Server Component
const cleanedData = records.map(record => {
  // Create a plain object with only needed properties
  const cleanRecord = {
    id: record.id,
    // Include other fields you need
  };
  
  // If you need file data, include only essential properties
  if (record.file) {
    cleanRecord.file = {
      name: record.file.name,
      url: record.file.url,
      // Other safe properties, avoiding methods/complex objects
    };
  }
  
  return cleanRecord;
});

const serializedData = JSON.stringify(cleanedData);
<ClientComponent data={serializedData} />
```

This approach gives you full control over exactly what gets serialized and prevents the complex file objects from causing issues at the RSC boundary.

+ /**
+  * Utilities for safely serializing Xata records to pass from
+  * Server Components to Client Components in Next.js
+  */
+ 
+ /**
+  * Safely serializes Xata records by removing non-serializable properties
+  * and converting to plain JavaScript objects.
+  *
+  * @param records - A single Xata record or array of records
+  * @returns Plain JavaScript object(s) safe for client components
+  */
+ export function serializeXataRecords&lt;T extends Record&lt;string, any&gt;&gt;(
+ 	records: T | T[] | null | undefined,
+ ): Partial&lt;T&gt; | Partial&lt;T&gt;[] | null {
+ 	if (!records) return null;
+ 
+ 	const serializeRecord = (record: T): Partial&lt;T&gt; =&gt; {
+ 		// Use toSerializable if available
+ 		if (typeof record.toSerializable === "function") {
+ 			const serialized = record.toSerializable();
+ 			// Remove xata object which we never need
+ 			if (serialized.xata) {
+ 				delete serialized.xata;
+ 			}
+ 			return serialized;
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Otherwise manually create a safe object
+ 		const safeObject: Partial&lt;T&gt; = {};
+ 
+ 		for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(record)) {
+ 			// Skip the xata object completely
+ 			if (key === "xata") continue;
+ 
+ 			// Skip functions and symbols
+ 			if (typeof value === "function" || typeof value === "symbol") continue;
+ 
+ 			// Handle arrays (including file arrays)
+ 			if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+ 				safeObject[key as keyof T] = value.map((item) =&gt; {
+ 					// For file objects, only keep safe properties
+ 					if (
+ 						item &amp;&amp;
+ 						typeof item === "object" &amp;&amp;
+ 						("mediaType" in item || "name" in item || "url" in item)
+ 					) {
+ 						return {
+ 							name: item.name,
+ 							mediaType: item.mediaType,
+ 							url: item.url,
+ 							size: item.size,
+ 							// Exclude problematic fields like signedUrl, uploadUrl, enablePublicUrl, etc.
+ 						};
+ 					}
+ 					return item;
+ 				}) as any;
+ 				continue;
+ 			}
+ 
+ 			// Handle file objects
+ 			if (
+ 				value &amp;&amp;
+ 				typeof value === "object" &amp;&amp;
+ 				("mediaType" in value || "signedUrl" in value || "uploadUrl" in value)
+ 			) {
+ 				safeObject[key as keyof T] = {
+ 					name: value.name,
+ 					mediaType: value.mediaType,
+ 					url: value.url,
+ 					size: value.size,
+ 					// Exclude problematic fields
+ 				} as any;
+ 				continue;
+ 			}
+ 
+ 			// Handle nested objects (recursive serialization)
+ 			if (value &amp;&amp; typeof value === "object" &amp;&amp; !Array.isArray(value)) {
+ 				safeObject[key as keyof T] = serializeRecord(value as any) as any;
+ 				continue;
+ 			}
+ 
+ 			// Otherwise include the value directly
+ 			safeObject[key as keyof T] = value as any;
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		return safeObject;
+ 	};
+ 
+ 	// Handle array of records
+ 	if (Array.isArray(records)) {
+ 		return records.map(serializeRecord);
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// Handle single record
+ 	return serializeRecord(records);
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Simple function to safely stringify data for passing to client components
+  *
+  * @param data - Any data to be stringified
+  * @returns JSON string representation of the data
+  */
+ export function safeStringify(data: any): string {
+ 	return JSON.stringify(serializeXataRecords(data));
+ }
+

_**Agent**_

You're encountering a classic issue with Three.js in Next.js server components. The error occurs because Three.js (and its related libraries like `three-conic-polygon-geometry` and `three-globe`) are trying to access the browser's `window` object during server-side rendering, where it doesn't exist.

To fix this, you need to make the Three.js component client-side only:

1. First, add the "use client" directive at the top of your ThreeJS globe component:

```tsx
"use client";

// Rest of your imports and code
```

2. If that's not enough, you'll need to dynamically import the component with the `ssr: false` option:

```tsx
// In the parent component that uses the globe
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic';

const ThreeJSGlobe = dynamic(
  () => import('@/components/globes/threejs-globe'),
  { ssr: false } // This prevents the component from being rendered on the server
);

// Then use it in your component
return (
  <div>
    <ThreeJSGlobe />
  </div>
);
```

3. If you're still having issues, you might need to conditionally import the Three.js libraries:

```tsx
"use client";
import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';

export default function ThreeJSGlobe() {
  const [Globe, setGlobe] = useState(null);
  const containerRef = useRef(null);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    // Only import Three.js libraries in the browser
    import('three-globe').then((module) => {
      setGlobe(module.default);
    });
  }, []);
  
  return <div ref={containerRef}>{Globe && /* render your globe */}</div>;
}
```

This approach ensures the Three.js code only runs in the browser, avoiding the "Can't find variable: window" error during server rendering.
